patches.name: Bypass license check
patches.description: Skip the Pairip license check when Grok starts.

patches.name: Copy prompt
patches.description: Add a post menu item with the copy icon that copies the current media prompt. It appears only for finished, non-moderated media (so the Retry action stays visible for failed or moderated generations) and only when the prompt is not empty. The 1.2.59 model has no seed, so seeds are not copied. Not tested on a device.

patches.name: Ignore Team/Org Imagine lock
patches.description: Make the app treat Imagine as allowed even when a Team/Org setting disables it, so the Imagine tab and entry points stay available. Only the app UI is changed: the server may still refuse Imagine requests, and the setting overridden is one an organization admin chose. Use only on accounts you control. Off by default; not tested on a device.

patches.name: Keep screen on
patches.description: Keep the screen on for as long as Grok is in the foreground, including while reading chat. The flag is cleared when the activity pauses. Uses more battery, so it is off by default; not tested on a device.
